name: Peshawari Spicy Chicken Karahi
vibe_description: A fiery, sizzling wok-cooked chicken dish bursting with green chilies, crushed black pepper, ginger, and jammy tomatoes. Ideal when you want bold heat that wakes up your tastebuds.
ingredients: Fresh julienned ginger and cilantro for garnish
steps: Heat oil in a wok or karahi over high heat and sear chicken with salt and ginger-garlic paste for 8 minutes until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes, cover, and cook for 8 minutes until skins soften; peel and discard skins.
Mash tomatoes into a thick masala and stir-fry on high heat for 10 minutes until oil separates.
Toss in slit green chilies, chili flakes, cumin, and black pepper; stir-fry 3 more minutes.
Garnish with julienned ginger and fresh cilantro; serve sizzling hot with naan.

name: Szechuan Fiery Chili Beef Stir-Fry
vibe_description: An intense, mouth-tingling stir-fry with Szechuan peppercorns, dried red chilies, and crispy seared beef strips. Built for spice lovers who want their tastebuds sizzling.
ingredients: 600g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
steps: Toss sliced beef with soy sauce and cornstarch; rest 10 minutes.
Heat wok until smoking, add chili oil, and sear beef in a single layer for 3 minutes until crisp at edges.
Add garlic, dried chilies, and crushed Szechuan peppercorns; stir-fry 45 seconds until fragrant.
Toss in bell pepper and scallions for 2 minutes until crisp-tender, then serve immediately.

name: Flame-Grilled Peri-Peri Chicken Bowl
vibe_description: Smoky, zesty, and punchy peri-peri marinated chicken breast paired with spiced rice. High in lean protein with a bright lemon-chili kick.
ingredients: 1 cup roasted corn and cucumber salsa
steps: Blend bird's eye chilies, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, smoked paprika, oregano, and salt into a fiery marinade.
Coat chicken breasts and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for 7-8 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Slice and serve over basmati rice topped with fresh corn and cucumber salsa.

name: Mass-Gainer Peanut Butter Banana Protein Oats
vibe_description: A thick, creamy, ultra calorie-dense breakfast bowl loaded with oats, whole milk, peanut butter, whey protein, and banana. Designed for hardgainers and clean bulking.
ingredients: 1 scoop (32g) vanilla or chocolate whey protein
steps: Simmer rolled oats, whole milk, chia seeds, and cinnamon in a saucepan for 5-6 minutes until thick.
Remove from heat and let cool for 1 minute before stirring in the whey protein powder smoothly.
Swirl in peanut butter and honey, then top with sliced banana and serve warm.

name: Loaded Steak, Rice & Avocado Bulk Bowl
vibe_description: A massive, calorie-dense power bowl combining seared cumin-lime steak, black beans, cilantro rice, cheddar cheese, and a whole avocado for serious energy and muscle recovery.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp chili powder
steps: Season steak cubes with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Sear steak in hot olive oil for 5-6 minutes until browned to medium.
Warm black beans and toss cooked rice with lime juice.
Assemble bowls with rice, beans, steak, shredded cheddar, avocado slices, and sour cream.

name: Creamy Tuscan Garlic Salmon Pasta
vibe_description: Velvety garlic parmesan cream sauce clinging to fettuccine with pan-seared salmon, sun-dried tomatoes, and wilted spinach. Rich, indulgent, and high in omega-3s and calories.
steps: Boil fettuccine in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Pan-sear seasoned salmon in butter for 4 minutes per side; set aside.
In the same pan, sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute, pour in heavy cream, and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan and spinach until melted and wilted, toss in pasta, and top with flaked salmon.

name: Tandoori Chicken Tikka Skewers
vibe_description: Juicy, smoky yogurt-marinated chicken cubes charred to perfection with garam masala and Kashmiri chili. Ultra lean protein for cutting or high-protein meal prep.
steps: Whisk Greek yogurt, spices, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, oil, and salt.
Coat chicken chunks and marinate for at least 20 minutes (or overnight).
Thread onto skewers and bake at 220°C (425°F) or air-fry for 14-15 minutes until charred at the edges.

name: Crispy Korean Gochujang Glazed Tofu
vibe_description: Crunchy pan-fried tofu cubes coated in a glossy, spicy-sweet Korean gochujang glaze over steamed rice. A bold, plant-based flavor bomb.
ingredients: 1 tsp sesame oil and toasted sesame seeds
steps: Toss pressed tofu cubes in cornstarch and pan-fry in a little oil for 8 minutes until golden and crispy.
Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, garlic, and 2 tbsp water.
Pour sauce into the pan and toss for 2 minutes until sticky and caramelized.
Serve over rice garnished with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

name: Power Protein Egg & Cottage Cheese Scramble
vibe_description: Fluffy, velvety scrambled eggs boosted with cottage cheese and spinach. A 10-minute breakfast packing 45 grams of protein with minimal carbs.
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, and chili flakes
steps: Whisk whole eggs, egg whites, cottage cheese, salt, and pepper together.
Sauté spinach and cherry tomatoes in olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Pour in egg mixture and gently fold on medium-low heat for 4-5 minutes until soft curds form.

name: Spicy Thai Red Curry Prawns
vibe_description: Fragrant coconut red curry simmered with lemongrass, Thai basil, bell peppers, and plump prawns. Balanced heat with rich tropical creaminess.
ingredients: 1 tbsp fish sauce or soy sauce
Handful of fresh Thai basil leaves
steps: Fry red curry paste in 2 tbsp of thick coconut cream for 2 minutes until aromatic.
Pour in remaining coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar; simmer 5 minutes.
Add bell pepper and prawns; cook 4-5 minutes until prawns turn pink.
Turn off heat, stir in lime juice and fresh Thai basil, and serve with jasmine rice.

name: Zesty Mediterranean Quinoa & Chickpea Bowl
vibe_description: Crisp, bright, and refreshing bowl of fluffy quinoa, roasted chickpeas, cucumber, feta, and lemon-oregano dressing. Perfect when you want something light and clean.
ingredients: Juice of 1 lemon and 1 tsp dried oregano
steps: Combine cooked quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, and feta in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle dressing over the bowl, toss gently, and serve chilled or at room temperature.

name: Smoky Garlic Red Lentil Dal (Tadka)
vibe_description: Cozy, velvety red lentils finished with a sizzling tempering of toasted cumin, crispy garlic, and red chilies. Wholesome comfort food packed with plant protein and fiber.
steps: Boil rinsed lentils with water, turmeric, tomato, and salt for 18-20 minutes until creamy.
Heat ghee in a small skillet, crackle cumin seeds, then fry sliced garlic and dried chilies until golden.
Pour the sizzling tadka directly over the hot dal, garnish with cilantro, and serve with rice or roti.

name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Crispy Potatoes
vibe_description: Juicy seared sirloin cubes bathed in herb garlic butter alongside golden crispy baby potatoes. Hearty, protein-packed, and satisfying after a heavy workout.
steps: Roast or pan-fry halved baby potatoes in olive oil with salt for 15 minutes until crispy and golden.
In a hot cast-iron skillet, sear seasoned steak bites in batches for 3 minutes until crusted.
Lower heat, add butter, garlic, and rosemary, and baste steak bites for 1 minute before serving with potatoes.

name: Spiced Paneer Bhurji Protein Wrap
vibe_description: Crumbled paneer sautéed with onions, green chilies, tomatoes, and garam masala, rolled into warm whole-wheat wraps with mint chutney. Fast vegetarian protein.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp garam masala
steps: Sauté onions and green chilies in oil for 4 minutes until translucent.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, garam masala, and salt; cook 3 minutes until soft.
Fold in crumbled paneer and cook 3 minutes until heated through.
Spread mint chutney on warm wraps, fill with paneer bhurji, roll tight, and toast lightly.

name: Air-Fried Nashville Hot Chicken Tenders
vibe_description: Ultra-crunchy chicken tenders brushed with a blazing cayenne-paprika hot oil glaze and served with tangy dill pickles. Serious crunch and tongue-tingling heat.
steps: Dip chicken tenders in buttermilk, then press firmly into panko breadcrumbs.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 13-15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Whisk cayenne, paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, and hot oil into a fiery glaze.
Brush hot glaze generously over crispy tenders and serve with pickles.

name: 1000-Calorie Chocolate Peanut Butter Bulk Shake
vibe_description: A drinkable 1,000-calorie powerhouse shake with oats, banana, whole milk, peanut butter, cocoa, and whey protein. The easiest way to hit a calorie surplus in 5 minutes.
steps: Blend rolled oats dry for 10 seconds into a fine powder.
Add whole milk, frozen banana, peanut butter, whey protein, cocoa powder, and honey.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until completely smooth and creamy; serve immediately.

name: Lemon-Pepper Tuna & Avocado Sourdough Toast
vibe_description: Crunchy toasted sourdough piled with smashed lemon-avocado and flaky tuna tossed in capers and black pepper. Ready in 10 minutes with 38g of clean protein.
ingredients: 1 tbsp Greek yogurt or olive oil
Red chili flakes and chopped parsley
steps: Toast sourdough slices until deeply golden and crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt; spread generously on toast.
Mix drained tuna with olive oil, black pepper, and parsley; pile on top and finish with chili flakes.

name: Velvety Classic Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
vibe_description: Tender charred chicken simmered in a silky spiced tomato, butter, and cashew-cream gravy with fenugreek leaves. Ultimate cozy, rich comfort food.
ingredients: 1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder and 1 tsp garam masala
steps: Pan-sear spiced chicken thigh cubes in 1 tbsp butter for 6 minutes until lightly charred; set aside.
Sauté ginger-garlic paste in remaining butter, add crushed tomatoes and spices, and simmer 12 minutes.
Blend sauce smooth with cashew paste, return to pan, and stir in heavy cream and chicken.
Simmer 6 minutes until thickened, crush fenugreek leaves on top, and serve with garlic naan.

name: Smoky Chipotle Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos
vibe_description: Caramelized chipotle-roasted sweet potatoes paired with spiced black beans and tangy lime-cabbage slaw in warm corn tortillas.
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 tbsp chipotle in adobo sauce, minced
1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp cumin
1 cup shredded red cabbage with lime juice
steps: Toss diced sweet potatoes with olive oil, chipotle, cumin, paprika, and salt; roast at 210°C for 18 minutes.
Warm black beans with a pinch of cumin.
Char corn tortillas briefly over a flame or skillet.
Assemble tacos with roasted sweet potatoes, black beans, and zesty lime cabbage slaw.

name: Honey Garlic Teriyaki Salmon & Broccoli
vibe_description: Flaky caramelized salmon fillets glazed in glossy soy-honey-ginger sauce alongside crisp steamed broccoli. Balanced, clean, and ready in 25 minutes.
ingredients: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 2 cloves garlic
steps: Whisk soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic.
Sear salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, flip, and pour teriyaki glaze into the pan.
Simmer 3-4 minutes, spooning glossy glaze over the fish until thickened.
Steam broccoli for 4 minutes and serve together sprinkled with sesame seeds.

name: Fiery Arrabbiata High-Protein Chickpea Pasta
vibe_description: Angry Italian tomato sauce loaded with toasted garlic and red pepper flakes tossed with protein-rich chickpea penne. Fast, spicy, and plant-powered.
steps: Boil chickpea pasta until al dente.
Gently sizzle sliced garlic and red chili flakes in olive oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes and salt; simmer 10 minutes until bright and thickened.
Toss pasta with the fiery sauce and fresh torn basil.

name: Turkish Cilbir (Garlic Yogurt & Chili Butter Eggs)
vibe_description: Silky poached eggs nestled on cool garlicky Greek yogurt and drizzled with sizzling Aleppo pepper butter. A restaurant-worthy 15-minute brunch.
ingredients: 1.5 tsp Aleppo pepper or paprika + chili flakes
Fresh dill and crusty bread for dipping
steps: Mix Greek yogurt with grated garlic and salt; spread onto two shallow bowls.
Poach eggs in gently simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3 minutes.
Melt butter until foaming and stir in Aleppo pepper.
Place poached eggs over yogurt, drizzle with sizzling chili butter, and garnish with dill.

name: High-Protein Beef Cheeseburger Mac
vibe_description: A one-pot, ultra-cheesy comfort dish combining lean ground beef, macaroni, sharp cheddar, and smoky mustard sauce. Built for big appetites and high protein targets.
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder
steps: Brown ground beef with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Stir in tomato paste, Dijon mustard, beef broth, milk, and uncooked macaroni.
Cover and simmer 12 minutes until pasta is tender and liquid is mostly absorbed.
Turn off heat and stir in shredded cheddar until melted and velvety.

name: Crunchy Green Edamame & Avocado Power Salad
vibe_description: Crisp shredded cabbage, shelled edamame, creamy avocado, and toasted almonds tossed in a zesty ginger-sesame lime dressing. Light, refreshing, and energizing.
ingredients: Juice of 1 lime and 1 tsp grated ginger
steps: Whisk sesame oil, soy sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger into a bright dressing.
Toss cabbage, edamame, avocado, and toasted almonds in a large bowl.
Drizzle with dressing right before serving so it stays crunchy.

name: Lahori Spiced Chana Masala
vibe_description: Rich, deeply spiced chickpeas simmered in caramelized onions, tomatoes, amchur (dried mango), and black cardamom. Punchy, tangy, and comforting.
ingredients: 1.5 tsp coriander powder and 1 tsp cumin
1 tsp red chili powder and 1/2 tsp amchur (mango powder)
steps: Caramelize chopped onions in oil for 8 minutes until deep golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and spices; cook 1 minute, then pour in pureed tomatoes.
Cook masala until oil separates, then add chickpeas and 1 cup water.
Simmer 12 minutes, lightly mashing a few chickpeas for thickness, and garnish with cilantro.

name: Sizzling Harissa Grilled Halloumi & Couscous
vibe_description: Squeaky golden-seared halloumi slices glazed with smoky rose harissa over lemon-herb couscous. Salty, fiery, and ready in 20 minutes.
ingredients: 1 cup roasted zucchini and bell peppers
Juice of 1/2 lemon and fresh mint
steps: Steep couscous in 1 cup boiling salted water for 5 minutes; fluff with lemon juice and mint.
Pan-sear halloumi slices in a dry non-stick skillet for 2 minutes per side until golden crusted.
Brush sizzling halloumi with harissa mixed with honey.
Serve over herby couscous alongside roasted vegetables.

name: High-Protein Greek Chicken Gyro Bowl
vibe_description: Lemon-oregano grilled chicken served with cool cucumber-dill tzatziki, warm pita, and crisp tomatoes. Fresh, clean, and loaded with 47g protein.
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 2 tsp dried oregano
1 clove garlic and 1 tbsp fresh dill
steps: Marinate chicken with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper for 15 minutes.
Mix Greek yogurt, squeezed cucumber, garlic, dill, and lemon into cool tzatziki.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet for 6-8 minutes until browned.
Serve with warm pita, fresh tomatoes, red onion, and generous tzatziki.

name: Calorie-Packed Smoked Salmon & Avocado Bagel
vibe_description: Toasted everything bagel layered with cream cheese, smashed avocado, smoked salmon, and a runny fried egg. Nutrient-rich, calorie-dense, and deeply satisfying.
ingredients: 1 tsp capers and cracked black pepper
steps: Toast the bagel until crisp.
Spread cream cheese on the bottom half and mashed avocado on the top.
Layer smoked salmon, capers, and a freshly fried egg; finish with black pepper.

name: Goan Fiery Beef Vindaloo
vibe_description: One of the boldest, most fiery curries around — slow-simmered beef infused with Kashmiri chilies, cider vinegar, garlic, cinnamon, and cloves for serious heat seekers.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp mustard seeds, 1 cinnamon stick
3 tbsp oil and 1 tsp brown sugar
steps: Blend soaked chilies, vinegar, garlic, ginger, cumin, and mustard seeds into a fiery paste.
Marinate beef cubes in the paste for at least 30 minutes.
Brown sliced onions in oil, add marinated beef and cinnamon stick, and sear 6 minutes.
Add 1.5 cups water, cover, and simmer 45-50 minutes until beef is fork-tender and sauce is thick.

name: 15-Minute Lemon Garlic Shrimp & Zucchini Noodles
vibe_description: Super light, ultra-low-calorie meal with juicy garlic-lemon shrimp tossed over crisp spiralized zucchini. Ideal for cutting or a clean 15-minute weeknight dinner.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp chili flakes and fresh parsley
steps: Sauté garlic and chili flakes in olive oil for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink and curled.
Toss in zucchini noodles, lemon juice, and zest for 2 minutes until just tender; garnish with parsley.

name: Creamy Spicy Peanut Satay Chicken Noodles
vibe_description: Chewy noodles coated in a thick, spicy peanut-sriracha-lime sauce with seared chicken and crushed peanuts. High-calorie, high-protein, and bursting with bold flavor.
ingredients: Juice of 1 lime and 1 tbsp honey
Crushed roasted peanuts and shredded carrots
steps: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Stir-fry sliced chicken until cooked through.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, sriracha, lime juice, honey, and warm water into a silky sauce.
Toss noodles, chicken, and carrots in the spicy peanut sauce and top with crushed peanuts.

name: Zesty Buffalo Roasted Cauliflower Wraps
vibe_description: Crisp roasted cauliflower florets tossed in tangy hot buffalo sauce and wrapped with cool ranch-yogurt slaw. A fiery, crunchy meatless dinner.
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into bite-size florets
steps: Toss cauliflower florets with olive oil, garlic powder, and salt; roast at 220°C for 18 minutes until crisp.
Toss hot roasted cauliflower in buffalo hot sauce.
Fill wraps with shredded lettuce, spicy cauliflower, and cool yogurt ranch; roll and slice.

name: Peshawari Chapli Kabab & Mint Raita
vibe_description: Crispy pan-seared spiced beef patties studded with crushed coriander, pomegranate seeds, and green chilies.
steps: Mix beef with spices, onion, tomato, and egg.
Flatten into thin patties and pan-fry in ghee 4 min per side.
Serve hot with mint yogurt raita.

name: Slow-Cooked Lahore Chicken Nihari
vibe_description: Silky, aromatic slow-simmered chicken stew spiced with long pepper, ginger, and toasted fennel.
steps: Sear chicken with ginger-garlic and nihari masala.
Simmer 35 min with 4 cups water.
Whisk flour slurry to thicken gravy and simmer 10 min; garnish with ginger.

name: Creamy Spinach & Paneer (Palak Paneer)
vibe_description: Velvety pureed spinach simmered with garlic, cumin, and golden cubes of fresh paneer.
steps: Blanch and puree spinach.
Sauté onion, garlic, tomatoes, and spices.
Simmer spinach puree with pan-seared paneer for 6 min.

name: Spicy Tomato Shakshuka with Feta
vibe_description: Runny poached eggs nestled in a bubbling harissa-spiced tomato and bell pepper sauce with salty feta.
steps: Sauté pepper, onion, and garlic in olive oil.
Simmer crushed tomatoes and harissa 10 min.
Crack eggs into wells, cover 5 min, top with feta.

name: Garlic Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowl
vibe_description: Warm-spiced roasted chicken thighs over turmeric rice with toum garlic sauce and pickled turnips.
steps: Marinate chicken with shawarma spice, lemon, and olive oil.
Sear or roast 14 min until charred.
Slice over turmeric rice with garlic sauce and pickles.

name: Crispy Beef Bibimbap Rice Bowl
vibe_description: Warm rice topped with marinated bulgogi beef, sautéed spinach, carrots, crispy fried egg, and spicy gochujang.
steps: Marinate beef in soy, garlic, and sesame oil; sear 4 min.
Sauté vegetables separately.
Assemble over rice with fried egg and gochujang.

name: Sweet Miso Glazed Black Cod
vibe_description: Tender flaky cod caramelized under the broiler with a rich white miso, mirin, and ginger glaze.
steps: Whisk miso, mirin, honey, and ginger.
Coat fillets and broil 8-10 min until bubbling and caramelized.
Serve with steamed bok choy.

name: Thai Basil Spicy Minced Chicken (Pad Kra Pao)
vibe_description: Wok-seared minced chicken tossed with bird's eye chilies, garlic, oyster sauce, and holy basil over jasmine rice.
ingredients: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce
steps: Pound garlic and chilies; sizzle in hot wok 30 sec.
Stir-fry ground chicken 5 min until browned.
Add sauces and basil; serve over rice with a crispy fried egg.

name: Crispy Peanut Kung Pao Tofu
vibe_description: Golden tofu cubes stir-fried with roasted peanuts, dried red chilies, bell peppers, and tangy black vinegar glaze.
ingredients: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp black vinegar
steps: Pan-fry tofu until crisp.
Sauté chilies, garlic, and bell pepper.
Toss tofu, peanuts, and soy-vinegar sauce 2 min until glossy.

name: Herb-Crusted Lemon Baked Salmon
vibe_description: Flaky salmon baked with lemon slices, dill, parsley, and olive oil for an effortless clean dinner.
steps: Rub salmon with olive oil, garlic, herbs, salt, and pepper.
Top with lemon slices and bake at 200°C for 12-14 min.

name: Lean Turkey Meatballs & Marinara Zoodles
vibe_description: Juicy herb-seasoned turkey meatballs simmered in garlic marinara over spiralized zucchini noodles.
steps: Mix turkey, egg, almond flour, and herbs; form meatballs and bake 15 min.
Simmer in marinara 5 min and serve over sautéed zoodles.

name: Sizzling Beef Fajita Skillet
vibe_description: Cast-iron seared cumin-lime flank steak strips with charred bell peppers and sweet onions.
steps: Toss steak and veggies with spices, oil, and lime.
Sear in a screaming-hot cast-iron skillet 6-8 min until charred.

name: Crispy Spiced Beef & Black Bean Power Bowl
vibe_description: Citrus-braised shredded beef crisped in a skillet over cilantro-lime rice, black beans, and pico de gallo.
steps: Crisp braised beef in a hot skillet with cumin and orange juice.
Layer over rice and black beans; top with pico and avocado.

name: 20-Minute Coconut Chickpea & Spinach Curry
vibe_description: Velvety coconut curry loaded with chickpeas, baby spinach, ginger, and garam masala.
ingredients: 1 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp garam masala
steps: Sauté ginger-garlic and spices 1 min.
Add coconut milk and chickpeas; simmer 10 min.
Fold in spinach until wilted; serve with rice.

name: Berry Cheesecake Protein Overnight Oats
vibe_description: Chilled creamy oats soaked with Greek yogurt, vanilla whey, chia seeds, and mixed berries.
steps: Whisk milk, yogurt, whey, and chia seeds.
Stir in oats, top with berries, and refrigerate overnight.

name: Spicy Mayo Salmon Poke Bowl
vibe_description: Sushi-grade salmon cubes tossed in soy-sesame marinade over sushi rice with avocado, edamame, and sriracha mayo.
ingredients: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
steps: Marinate salmon in soy and sesame oil.
Assemble bowl with rice, salmon, avocado, edamame, and sriracha mayo.

name: Crunchy Cheddar Tuna Melt Wrap
vibe_description: Crispy toasted tortilla stuffed with lemon-herb tuna salad and melted sharp cheddar.
steps: Mix tuna, yogurt, mustard, and celery.
Spread on tortilla with cheddar, fold, and pan-toast 3 min per side.

name: High-Protein Cottage Cheese Chicken Alfredo
vibe_description: Rich garlic parmesan Alfredo sauce blended from cottage cheese instead of heavy cream, tossed with pasta and grilled chicken.
steps: Boil pasta and grill seasoned chicken.
Blend cottage cheese smooth with warm pasta water, garlic, and parmesan.
Toss pasta and sliced chicken in the silky sauce.

name: Double-Beef Creamy Rigatoni Bulk Bake
vibe_description: Heavyweight rigatoni loaded with ground beef, ricotta, marinara, and melted mozzarella for serious bulking.
steps: Brown beef and simmer with marinara.
Toss with cooked rigatoni and ricotta, top with mozzarella, and broil 5 min.

name: 800-Calorie Almond Butter, Banana & Egg Power Toast
vibe_description: Two thick slices of sourdough — one loaded with almond butter, banana, and hemp seeds, the other with mashed avocado and 2 fried eggs.
steps: Toast bread.
Top slice 1 with almond butter, banana, and hemp seeds; top slice 2 with avocado and fried eggs.

name: High-Protein Crispy Tofu Pad Thai
vibe_description: Rice noodles stir-fried in tangy tamarind-lime sauce with crispy tofu, bean sprouts, and crushed peanuts.
ingredients: 3 tbsp tamarind paste, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sugar
steps: Soak noodles and pan-fry tofu until crisp.
Stir-fry noodles with tamarind sauce, tofu, and sprouts; top with peanuts.

name: Fiery Fra Diavolo Shrimp Linguine
vibe_description: Plump shrimp simmered in a blazing crushed-tomato, garlic, and calabrian chili sauce over linguine.
steps: Sizzle garlic and chili flakes in olive oil.
Simmer crushed tomatoes 8 min, add shrimp for 3 min, and toss with linguine.

name: Moroccan Harissa Lamb & Chickpea Couscous
vibe_description: Cumin-and-cinnamon seared lamb strips served over fluffy saffron couscous with chickpeas and smoky harissa.
steps: Sear spiced lamb in olive oil 6 min.
Fluff couscous with chickpeas and serve topped with lamb and harissa.

name: Herb Garlic Chicken Thighs & Cheesy Mash
vibe_description: Golden crispy-skin chicken thighs with pan gravy served over buttery cheddar mashed potatoes.
steps: Pan-roast chicken thighs skin-side down until crisp.
Boil and mash potatoes with butter, cream, and cheddar; serve with pan juices.

name: Loaded Steak & Cheddar Keto Omelet
vibe_description: Three-egg omelet stuffed with leftover seared steak strips, sharp cheddar, mushrooms, and chives.
steps: Sauté mushrooms in butter, pour in whisked eggs.
Add steak and cheddar, fold, and melt.

name: Charred Lemongrass Chicken Vermicelli Bowl
vibe_description: Fragrant lemongrass-garlic grilled chicken over cool rice vermicelli with crisp cucumber, herbs, and nuoc cham.
steps: Marinate chicken in lemongrass, garlic, and fish sauce; grill 10 min.
Serve over vermicelli with fresh herbs and lime dressing.

name: Basil Pesto Chicken & Mozzarella Panini
vibe_description: Pressed sourdough panini packed with grilled chicken, basil pesto, fresh mozzarella, and sun-dried tomatoes.
steps: Layer pesto, chicken, mozzarella, and tomatoes between sourdough.
Press in a hot skillet 3 min per side until melty and crisp.

name: Hearty Lemon-Oregano Greek Lentil Soup
vibe_description: Nourishing brown lentil soup simmered with carrots, celery, garlic, rosemary, and finished with lemon and feta.
steps: Sauté veggies and garlic in olive oil.
Simmer lentils and broth 25 min.
Finish with lemon juice and crumbled feta.

name: Spicy Cajun Blackened Tilapia & Corn Salsa
vibe_description: Lean white fish fillets crusted in smoky Cajun spices and seared in a hot skillet, served with sweet corn salsa.
ingredients: 1 cup charred corn, tomato, lime salsa
steps: Coat fish in Cajun spice and sear 3 min per side.
Serve immediately with bright corn-lime salsa.

name: Spicy Sriracha Tuna Crispy Rice Bites
vibe_description: Golden pan-fried sushi rice cakes topped with spicy sriracha-mayo tuna tartare and sliced jalapeño.
ingredients: 2 tbsp sriracha mayo, 1 tsp soy sauce
steps: Press rice flat, cut into squares, and pan-fry until crisp.
Top with spicy tuna mixture and jalapeño.

name: High-Protein Chipotle Chicken Quesadilla
vibe_description: Crispy golden tortilla filled with smoky chipotle-shredded chicken, black beans, and melted Monterey Jack.
steps: Toss chicken with chipotle sauce.
Fill tortillas with chicken, beans, and cheese; griddle 3 min per side.

name: Smoky Tandoori Paneer Tikka & Mint Rice
vibe_description: Charred yogurt-and-spice marinated paneer and bell peppers over fragrant basmati rice with cooling mint chutney.
ingredients: 1/3 cup Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp tandoori masala
steps: Marinate paneer and veggies in spiced yogurt.
Roast at 220°C for 14 min until charred; serve over rice.

name: Spiced Beef Keema & Green Peas
vibe_description: Classic Pakistani minced beef sautéed with ginger, garlic, whole spices, tomatoes, and sweet green peas.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp garam masala
steps: Brown onions, add ginger-garlic and beef.
Cook with tomatoes and spices 15 min, then simmer peas 5 min.

name: 15-Minute Garlic Butter Shrimp & Rice
vibe_description: Succulent shrimp seared in browned garlic butter with lemon juice and parsley over steamed white rice.
steps: Sauté garlic in butter 30 sec, sear shrimp 4 min.
Add lemon and parsley; spoon over warm rice.

name: Rich Vegan Red Lentil & Mushroom Bolognese
vibe_description: Thick, meaty plant-based ragù made from finely chopped mushrooms, red lentils, garlic, and crushed tomatoes.
steps: Sauté mushrooms and garlic.
Simmer lentils and crushed tomatoes 20 min until thick; toss with spaghetti.

name: Honey Mustard Glazed Chicken & Quinoa
vibe_description: Juicy pan-seared chicken breast brushed with Dijon-honey glaze over fluffy quinoa and roasted green beans.
steps: Pan-sear chicken 6 min per side, brushing with honey-mustard glaze.
Serve with quinoa and roasted green beans.

name: Crispy Whey Protein Waffles & Greek Yogurt
vibe_description: Golden oat-and-whey waffles topped with vanilla Greek yogurt, fresh strawberries, and sugar-free syrup.
steps: Whisk batter and cook in waffle iron 4 min until crisp.
Top with Greek yogurt and berries.

name: Crunchy Thai Peanut & Crispy Tofu Salad
vibe_description: Shredded red cabbage, carrots, edamame, and baked tofu tossed in a punchy chili-lime peanut dressing.
ingredients: 3 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp sriracha, lime juice
steps: Whisk peanut butter, sriracha, soy, and lime.
Toss crunchy veggies and tofu with dressing.

name: Fiery Gochujang Beef Bulgogi Bowls
vibe_description: Thinly sliced ribeye caramelized in spicy gochujang, pear, garlic, and sesame oil over steamed rice.
ingredients: 2 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp honey
steps: Marinate beef in gochujang mixture.
Flash-sear in a smoking hot skillet 4 min; serve over rice.

name: Calorie-Dense Breakfast Egg, Cheese & Avocado Quesadilla
vibe_description: Crispy tortilla folded around 3 scrambled eggs, black beans, sharp cheddar, and half an avocado.
steps: Scramble eggs soft.
Fill tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese, and avocado; pan-toast until crisp.

name: Rich Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff
vibe_description: Tender seared beef strips and golden mushrooms in a velvety Dijon-sour cream gravy over egg noodles.
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 tbsp Dijon, 1 cup beef broth
steps: Sear beef and sauté mushrooms.
Simmer broth and Dijon, stir in sour cream off heat, and serve over noodles.

name: Air-Fried Bang Bang Salmon Bites
vibe_description: Bite-sized salmon cubes air-fried until crisp and drizzled with sweet-spicy sriracha mayo over rice.
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic powder, paprika
2 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp sriracha, 1 tsp honey
steps: Air-fry seasoned salmon cubes at 200°C for 8 min.
Drizzle with bang bang sauce and serve over rice.

name: Warm Spiced Eggplant & Chickpea Stew
vibe_description: Silky roasted eggplant simmered with chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, cumin, and cinnamon.
steps: Sauté eggplant in olive oil until browned.
Simmer with tomatoes, chickpeas, and spices 18 min.

name: High-Protein Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
vibe_description: Charred chicken breast, crisp romaine, shaved parmesan, and light Greek-yogurt Caesar dressing in a whole-wheat wrap.
steps: Toss romaine, chicken, parmesan, and dressing.
Roll tightly in warm wraps and slice.

name: 950-Calorie Mass-Gainer Granola & Nut Bowl
vibe_description: Crunchy protein granola drowned in whole milk, Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp almond butter, honey, and banana.
ingredients: 1 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt
steps: Layer granola, yogurt, milk, almond butter, banana, and honey in a large bowl.

name: Sheet-Pan Harissa Chicken & Sweet Potatoes
vibe_description: One-pan roasted chicken thighs and caramelized sweet potato cubes glazed in smoky harissa and honey.
ingredients: 2 tbsp harissa, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp olive oil
steps: Toss chicken and sweet potatoes in harissa glaze.
Roast at 215°C for 25-28 min until caramelized.

name: Fiery Jalapeño Popper Stuffed Chicken
vibe_description: Juicy chicken breasts stuffed with cream cheese, sharp cheddar, and diced jalapeños, baked until bubbling.
steps: Cut pockets into chicken breasts and stuff with cheese and jalapeños.
Sear 3 min, then bake at 200°C for 18 min.

name: 20-Minute Spicy Miso Tofu & Edamame Ramen
vibe_description: Steaming chili-miso broth loaded with ramen noodles, crispy tofu, shelled edamame, and sweet corn.
ingredients: 3 tbsp red miso, 1 tbsp chili oil
steps: Simmer broth with miso and chili oil.
Cook noodles, tofu, and veggies in broth 5 min and serve hot.

name: Weeknight Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
vibe_description: Fragrant saffron basmati rice layered with yogurt-marinated spiced chicken, fried onions, and fresh mint.
steps: Cook spiced chicken in yogurt 12 min.
Layer parboiled basmati rice on top, seal, and steam 15 min.

name: One-Pot Lemon Garlic Chicken & Orzo
vibe_description: Tender chicken and creamy parmesan-lemon orzo cooked together in one skillet with spinach.
ingredients: Juice of 1 lemon, 1/3 cup parmesan, 2 cups spinach
steps: Sear chicken, add orzo and broth, and simmer 12 min.
Stir in lemon, parmesan, and spinach.

name: Dark Chocolate Whey Chia Pudding
vibe_description: Thick, decadent chocolate pudding made with chia seeds, cocoa powder, chocolate whey, and almond milk.
ingredients: 1 tbsp cocoa powder, 1 tsp maple syrup
steps: Whisk all ingredients well.
Chill 2 hours or overnight until thick.

name: Fiery Szechuan Mapo Tofu with Beef
vibe_description: Silken tofu and minced beef simmered in blazing doubanjiang chili bean paste and numbing Szechuan peppercorn oil.
steps: Brown beef with garlic, ginger, and doubanjiang.
Simmer 1 cup broth with tofu 6 min, thicken with cornstarch, finish with Szechuan pepper.

name: 300-Calorie Cutting Chicken & Cauli-Rice Bowl
vibe_description: Ultra-lean herb-grilled chicken over cilantro-lime cauliflower rice and salsa for aggressive fat-loss phases.
steps: Grill seasoned chicken breast.
Sauté cauliflower rice 4 min with lime and cilantro; serve with salsa.

name: 1000-Calorie Steak & Gorgonzola Cream Pasta
vibe_description: Seared sirloin slices over penne drenched in heavy cream, gorgonzola, and parmesan — maximum calorie density.
steps: Boil penne and sear steak.
Simmer cream and cheeses into rich sauce, toss pasta and spinach, top with steak.

name: Crispy Herb Falafel & Garlic Hummus Plate
vibe_description: Parsley-cilantro chickpea falafel patties served over creamy hummus with warm pita and cucumber salad.
steps: Pulse chickpeas, herbs, garlic, and cumin; form patties and air-fry 14 min.
Serve over hummus with pita.

name: 20-Minute Sesame Beef & Broccoli
vibe_description: Tender seared flank steak and crisp broccoli florets coated in glossy garlic-ginger soy glaze over rice.
ingredients: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, garlic, ginger
steps: Sear steak 3 min; steam-sear broccoli 3 min.
Toss together with garlic-soy glaze and serve over rice.

name: Spicy Indian Egg Bhurji & Whole-Wheat Paratha
vibe_description: Fluffy masala scrambled eggs cooked with green chilies, onions, tomatoes, and turmeric alongside flaky paratha.
steps: Sauté onions, chilies, tomato, and spices.
Scramble in eggs until soft; serve hot with toasted paratha.

name: Lemon Dill Salmon & Quinoa Power Salad
vibe_description: Flaky roasted salmon over cool quinoa, baby arugula, avocado, and bright lemon-mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Bake or air-fry salmon 10 min.
Toss quinoa, arugula, and dressing; top with flaked salmon and avocado.

name: 10-Minute Sizzling Chili Oil Garlic Noodles
vibe_description: Chewy wheat noodles doused in hot sizzling oil poured directly over minced garlic, chili flakes, and scallions.
ingredients: 1.5 tbsp chili flakes, 1 tsp sesame seeds
2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp black vinegar
steps: Boil noodles and place in bowl.
Pile garlic, chili flakes, and scallions on top; pour smoking hot oil over to sizzle, then add soy and vinegar.

name: Cheesy Queso Chicken Fajita Rice Bowl
vibe_description: Spiced fajita chicken, charred peppers, and cilantro rice smothered in warm melted queso sauce.
steps: Sear seasoned chicken and peppers.
Serve over rice and drizzle generously with warm queso.

name: No-Cook Tuna & Chickpea Protein Salad
vibe_description: Zero-cooking 8-minute lunch combining flaky tuna, chickpeas, red onion, parsley, and lemon-olive oil.
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1/2 lemon
steps: Toss all ingredients in a bowl with salt and black pepper.

name: Smoky BBQ Pulled Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potato
vibe_description: Fluffy baked sweet potatoes split open and piled with tender smoky BBQ shredded chicken.
steps: Microwave or bake sweet potatoes until tender.
Warm shredded chicken in BBQ sauce and stuff into potatoes.

name: Velvety Coconut Curried Red Lentil Soup
vibe_description: Smooth, golden red lentil soup simmered with ginger, curry powder, and rich coconut milk.
steps: Sauté curry powder and ginger.
Simmer lentils and broth 18 min, blend smooth with coconut milk.

name: Crispy Baked Fiery Peri-Peri Chicken Wings
vibe_description: Oven-crisped chicken wings tossed in a blazing lemon-garlic bird's eye chili peri-peri sauce.
ingredients: 4 bird's eye chilies, garlic, lemon, smoked paprika, oil
steps: Toss wings with baking powder and bake at 220°C for 35 min until crisp.
Toss in blended peri-peri sauce.

name: Cinnamon Vanilla Protein French Toast
vibe_description: Thick brioche or whole-wheat slices soaked in egg-white and vanilla whey custard, griddled golden.
ingredients: 1/2 cup egg whites, 1 scoop vanilla whey
steps: Whisk egg whites, whey, milk, and cinnamon.
Dip bread and griddle 3 min per side; top with berries.

name: Rich Creamy Paneer Tikka Masala
vibe_description: Charred paneer cubes simmered in a lush spiced tomato-butter-cream masala.
steps: Sear spiced paneer until golden.
Simmer tomato-butter masala 12 min, add cream and paneer.

name: Korean Street-Style Fluffy Egg & Cheese Toast
vibe_description: Buttered toasted brioche stuffed with soft-scrambled eggs, melted cheddar, and sweet sriracha mayo.
steps: Toast brioche in butter.
Fill with soft scrambled eggs, cheddar, and sriracha mayo.

name: 900-Calorie Steak, Egg & Crispy Potato Skillet
vibe_description: A massive single-skillet bulking meal: seared diced steak, crispy golden potatoes, cheddar, and 3 fried eggs.
steps: Pan-fry potatoes in butter until crisp.
Sear steak 4 min, top with cheddar and 3 fried eggs.
